defA2: To come into sight or become visible.
defReadAloud: To come into sight or become visible.

usages.label: 出现
usages.sentence: A rainbow appeared in the sky after the rain.
usages.sentenceZh: 雨后天空出现了一道彩虹。
usages.explain: 表示某物突然或逐渐变得可见。
usages.rephrase: After the rain, we saw a rainbow in the sky.

usages.label: 似乎
usages.sentence: She appears to be very happy with her new job.
usages.sentenceZh: 她似乎对新工作很满意。
usages.explain: 表示根据观察得出的印象或判断。
usages.rephrase: It seems that she is very happy with her new job.

usages.label: 出场
usages.sentence: The famous singer will appear on stage at 8 p.m.
usages.sentenceZh: 那位著名歌手将在晚上8点出场。
usages.explain: 指在公共场合或表演中露面。
usages.rephrase: The famous singer will come on stage at 8 p.m.

derivatives.exampleSentence: Her sudden appearance at the party surprised everyone.
derivatives.exampleZh: 她突然出现在聚会上，让所有人都很惊讶。

induct.title: 动词变名词：-ance 后缀
induct.tip: 动词后加 -ance 常表示“行为、状态或结果”。

derivatives.exampleSentence: The magician made the rabbit disappear in a flash.
derivatives.exampleZh: 魔术师一眨眼就让兔子消失了。

induct.title: 否定前缀 dis-
induct.tip: dis- 加在动词或形容词前，表示“相反”或“否定”。

derivatives.exampleSentence: The disappearance of the old building made many people sad.
derivatives.exampleZh: 那座老建筑的消失让许多人感到难过。

induct.title: 否定动词变名词：dis- + 动词 + -ance
induct.tip: 先加否定前缀，再加名词后缀。

examExamples.readSentence: The sudden disappearance of the key caused a lot of trouble.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 钥匙的突然消失引起了很多麻烦。

examExamples.readSentence: Her appearance at the meeting was unexpected.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 她在会议上的出现是出乎意料的。

examExamples.readSentence: The magician made the coin disappear right before our eyes.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 魔术师让硬币在我们眼前消失了。

examExamples.readSentence: He appeared to be very tired after the long journey.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 长途旅行后，他显得很疲惫。

examTarget.note: 考点：disappearance 是 appear 的否定名词形式。提醒掌握 appear → appearance → disappear → disappearance 整族变形。

usages.label: 错误的
usages.sentence: I gave the wrong answer in the math test.
usages.sentenceZh: 我在数学考试中给出了错误的答案。
usages.rephrase: My answer in the math test was not correct.

usages.label: 出问题
usages.sentence: Something is wrong with my phone; it won't turn on.
usages.sentenceZh: 我的手机出问题了，它开不了机。
usages.explain: 表示某物功能不正常或存在故障。
usages.rephrase: My phone doesn't work; there is a problem.

usages.label: 不道德
usages.sentence: It is wrong to cheat on an exam.
usages.sentenceZh: 考试作弊是不对的。
usages.rephrase: Cheating on an exam is not right.

derivatives.exampleSentence: He was wrongly accused of stealing the money.
derivatives.exampleZh: 他被错误地指控偷了钱。

induct.title: 形容词变副词：-ly 后缀
induct.tip: 多数形容词加 -ly 构成副词，修饰动词或整个句子。

derivatives.exampleSentence: The wrongness of his decision became clear later.
derivatives.exampleZh: 他决定的错误性后来变得很明显。

induct.title: 形容词变名词：-ness 后缀
induct.tip: -ness 加在形容词后，表示“性质或状态”。

examExamples.readSentence: She was wrongly punished for something she didn't do.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 她因为没做过的事而被错误地惩罚了。

examExamples.readSentence: It is wrong to tell lies.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 说谎是不对的。

examExamples.readSentence: The wrongness of his action was obvious to everyone.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 他行为的错误性对每个人来说都很明显。

examTarget.note: 考点：wrongly 是 wrong 的副词形式。提醒掌握 wrong → wrongly → wrongness 整族变形。

defA2: Moving or happening at a fast speed.
defReadAloud: Moving or happening at a fast speed.

usages.label: 快速的
usages.sentence: We had a quick lunch before the meeting.
usages.sentenceZh: 我们在会议前快速吃了午餐。
usages.rephrase: We ate lunch fast before the meeting.

usages.label: 敏捷的
usages.sentence: The rabbit is quick to run away from danger.
usages.sentenceZh: 兔子能迅速逃离危险。
usages.rephrase: The rabbit runs away from danger very fast.

usages.label: 立刻的
usages.sentence: Please give me a quick answer.
usages.sentenceZh: 请给我一个快速的答复。
usages.rephrase: Please answer me quickly.

derivatives.exampleSentence: He quickly finished his homework and went out to play.
derivatives.exampleZh: 他很快完成了作业，然后出去玩了。

induct.title: 形容词变副词：-ly 后缀
induct.tip: 多数形容词加 -ly 构成副词。

derivatives.exampleSentence: This route is quicker than the one we took yesterday.
derivatives.exampleZh: 这条路线比我们昨天走的那条更快。

induct.title: 形容词比较级：-er 后缀
induct.tip: 单音节形容词加 -er 构成比较级。

derivatives.exampleSentence: She is the quickest runner in our class.
derivatives.exampleZh: 她是我们班跑得最快的。

induct.title: 形容词最高级：-est 后缀
induct.tip: 单音节形容词加 -est 构成最高级，常与 the 连用。

examExamples.readSentence: A train is quicker than a bus.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 火车比公共汽车快。

examExamples.readSentence: He quickly ran to the door when he heard the bell.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 听到铃声，他迅速跑向门口。

examExamples.readSentence: This is the quickest way to get to the station.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 这是去车站最快的方法。

examExamples.readSentence: Be quick! The bus is coming.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 快点！公交车来了。

examTarget.note: 考点：quicker 是 quick 的比较级形式。提醒掌握 quick → quickly → quicker → quickest 整族变形。

defA2: To separate something into two or more parts.
defReadAloud: To separate something into two or more parts.

usages.label: 分开
usages.sentence: Let's divide the pizza into eight slices.
usages.sentenceZh: 我们把披萨分成八块吧。
usages.rephrase: Let's cut the pizza into eight pieces.

usages.label: 分配
usages.sentence: The teacher divided the students into groups.
usages.sentenceZh: 老师把学生分成小组。
usages.explain: 按一定方式分配人员或资源。
usages.rephrase: The teacher put the students into different groups.

usages.label: 分歧
usages.sentence: Opinions are divided on this issue.
usages.sentenceZh: 在这个问题上意见有分歧。
usages.rephrase: People have different opinions on this issue.

derivatives.exampleSentence: The teacher divided the class into four groups for the project.
derivatives.exampleZh: 老师把班级分成四个小组做这个项目。

induct.title: 动词过去式规则变化
induct.tip: 以e结尾直接加d

derivatives.exampleSentence: The division of labor made the work much easier.
derivatives.exampleZh: 劳动分工使工作容易多了。

induct.title: 动词变名词：-sion
induct.tip: 以de结尾的动词常变sion

derivatives.note: 动词divide的形容词形式，-ible结尾
derivatives.exampleSentence: Twelve is divisible by three, but not by five.
derivatives.exampleZh: 12可以被3整除，但不能被5整除。

induct.title: 形容词后缀-ible
induct.tip: -ible常表示“可…的”

examExamples.readSentence: The cake was divided equally among the children.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 蛋糕被平均分给了孩子们。

examExamples.readSentence: The division of the kingdom caused many wars.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 王国的分裂引发了许多战争。

examExamples.readSentence: Is this number divisible by seven?
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 这个数能被7整除吗？

examTarget.note: 考点：被动语态 was divided，注意区分 divide/divided/division/divisible 的词性和用法

usages.label: 阻止
usages.sentence: Wearing a seatbelt can prevent injuries in a car accident.
usages.sentenceZh: 系安全带可以防止车祸中的伤害。
usages.explain: 采取措施避免不良后果。
usages.rephrase: Wearing a seatbelt helps stop injuries in a car accident.

usages.label: 预防
usages.sentence: Washing hands often helps prevent the spread of germs.
usages.sentenceZh: 经常洗手有助于预防细菌传播。
usages.rephrase: Washing hands often can stop germs from spreading.

usages.label: 妨碍
usages.sentence: The heavy rain prevented us from going out.
usages.sentenceZh: 大雨阻止了我们外出。
usages.rephrase: We couldn't go out because of the heavy rain.

derivatives.exampleSentence: The prevention of disease is better than cure.
derivatives.exampleZh: 预防疾病胜于治疗。

induct.title: 动词变名词：-tion
induct.tip: 以t结尾的动词常加ion

derivatives.note: 动词prevent的形容词形式，-able结尾
derivatives.exampleSentence: Many accidents are preventable if we follow the rules.
derivatives.exampleZh: 如果我们遵守规则，许多事故是可以预防的。

induct.title: 形容词后缀-able
induct.tip: -able表示“可…的”

examExamples.readSentence: We should take action to prevent the spread of the virus.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 我们应该采取行动防止病毒传播。

examExamples.readSentence: The prevention of forest fires is everyone's duty.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 预防森林火灾是每个人的责任。

examExamples.readSentence: Most of these diseases are preventable with proper care.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 这些疾病大多可以通过适当护理来预防。

examTarget.note: 考点：不定式 to prevent，注意 prevent 与 prevention/preventable 的词性转换

defA2: The physical or mental energy needed to do something.
defReadAloud: The physical or mental energy needed to do something.

usages.label: 努力
usages.sentence: It takes a lot of effort to learn a new language.
usages.sentenceZh: 学习一门新语言需要付出很多努力。
usages.explain: 指为达成目标而付出的精力。
usages.rephrase: Learning a new language requires hard work.

usages.label: 尝试
usages.sentence: She made an effort to be friendly to the new student.
usages.sentenceZh: 她努力对新同学表示友好。
usages.rephrase: She tried to be friendly to the new student.

usages.label: 成果
usages.sentence: His efforts finally paid off when he won the prize.
usages.sentenceZh: 他的努力最终得到了回报，他赢得了奖项。
usages.rephrase: He worked hard and finally won the prize.

derivatives.exampleSentence: All our efforts finally paid off.
derivatives.exampleZh: 我们所有的努力终于得到了回报。

induct.title: 可数名词复数
induct.tip: effort 常以复数形式表示多次努力

derivatives.exampleSentence: Her dance looked so effortless that everyone admired her.
derivatives.exampleZh: 她的舞蹈看起来毫不费力，大家都钦佩她。

induct.title: 形容词后缀-less
induct.tip: -less表示“没有…的”

derivatives.exampleSentence: He solved the difficult problem effortlessly.
derivatives.exampleZh: 他毫不费力地解决了这个难题。

induct.title: 形容词变副词：-ly
induct.tip: 以-ful结尾的形容词变副词去y加ily

examExamples.readSentence: With great efforts, he finally passed the exam.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 经过巨大的努力，他终于通过了考试。

examExamples.readSentence: The swimmer made an effortless dive into the pool.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 游泳运动员毫不费力地跳入泳池。

examExamples.readSentence: She finished the race effortlessly and won the gold medal.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 她毫不费力地跑完了比赛并赢得了金牌。

examTarget.note: 考点：名词复数 efforts，注意 effort/efforts/effortless/effortlessly 的词性变化

defA2: Something that is kept hidden or known only by a few people.
defReadAloud: Something that is kept hidden or known only by a few people.

usages.label: 秘密
usages.sentence: Can you keep a secret? I'm planning a surprise party.
usages.sentenceZh: 你能保守秘密吗？我正在计划一个惊喜派对。
usages.rephrase: Don't tell anyone, but I'm planning a surprise party.

usages.label: 秘诀
usages.sentence: The secret to success is hard work.
usages.sentenceZh: 成功的秘诀是努力工作。
usages.explain: 指达成某事的关键方法。
usages.rephrase: To be successful, you need to work hard.

usages.label: 隐秘的
usages.sentence: They met at a secret location.
usages.sentenceZh: 他们在秘密地点见面。
usages.explain: 形容词，表示不为人知的。
usages.rephrase: They met at a place that no one knew about.

derivatives.note: secret 的复数形式，表示多个秘密
derivatives.exampleSentence: She told me all her secrets about the surprise party.
derivatives.exampleZh: 她告诉了我所有关于惊喜派对的秘密。

induct.title: 名词复数变化
induct.tip: 以 t 结尾的名词加 s 构成复数

derivatives.note: secret + ly 构成副词，表示秘密地
derivatives.exampleSentence: He secretly left a note on her desk before class.
derivatives.exampleZh: 他上课前偷偷在她桌上留了张纸条。

induct.title: 形容词变副词加 ly
induct.tip: 大多数形容词加 ly 构成副词

derivatives.note: secret 的名词变体，强调保密状态
derivatives.exampleSentence: The success of the project depended on complete secrecy.
derivatives.exampleZh: 这个项目的成功完全依赖于保密。

induct.title: 抽象名词后缀 -cy
induct.tip: 形容词或名词加 cy 构成抽象名词

examExamples.readSentence: She smiled secretly when she heard the good news.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 她听到好消息时偷偷地笑了。

examExamples.readSentence: They kept the plan a secret from everyone else.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 他们对其他人保密了这个计划。

examExamples.readSentence: The two friends shared their deepest secrets with each other.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 这两个朋友互相分享了他们最深的秘密。

examExamples.readSentence: The government insisted on total secrecy during the negotiations.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 政府在谈判期间坚持完全保密。

examTarget.note: 考点：secret 的词族变形（名词、副词、抽象名词）常出现在完形填空和语法填空，需掌握 secretly 的副词用法及 secrecy 的抽象名词形式。

defA2: During the time that something is happening.
defReadAloud: During the time that something is happening.

usages.label: 当……时
usages.sentence: I listened to music while I was doing my homework.
usages.sentenceZh: 我做作业时听音乐。
usages.explain: 表示两个动作同时发生。
usages.rephrase: I did my homework and listened to music at the same time.

usages.label: 然而
usages.sentence: Some people like summer, while others prefer winter.
usages.sentenceZh: 有些人喜欢夏天，而另一些人更喜欢冬天。
usages.rephrase: Some people like summer, but others like winter better.

usages.label: 一会儿
usages.sentence: Wait here for a while; I'll be back soon.
usages.sentenceZh: 在这儿等一会儿，我很快就回来。
usages.rephrase: Stay here for a short time; I'll come back soon.

derivatives.note: while 的复合词，表示与此同时
derivatives.exampleSentence: Mom was cooking dinner; meanwhile, Dad was setting the table.
derivatives.exampleZh: 妈妈在做晚饭；与此同时，爸爸在摆桌子。

induct.title: 复合副词 meanwhile
induct.tip: meanwhile 常用于连接两个同时发生的动作

examExamples.readSentence: Please wait here while I get the tickets.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 请在这里等我取票。

examExamples.readSentence: He listened to music while doing his homework.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 他一边做作业一边听音乐。

examExamples.readSentence: The children were playing outside; meanwhile, their parents were preparing lunch.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 孩子们在外面玩；与此同时，他们的父母在准备午餐。

examExamples.readSentence: While I understand your point, I still disagree.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 虽然我理解你的观点，但我仍然不同意。

examTarget.note: 考点：while 作连词表示“当……时”或“虽然”，meanwhile 作副词表示“与此同时”，需注意词性区别。

defA2: To feel sad or sorry about something that happened or you did.
defReadAloud: To feel sad or sorry about something that happened or you did.

usages.label: 后悔
usages.sentence: I regret not studying harder for the exam.
usages.sentenceZh: 我后悔没有为考试更努力地学习。
usages.explain: 对过去的行为感到遗憾。
usages.rephrase: I wish I had studied harder for the exam.

usages.label: 遗憾
usages.sentence: We regret to inform you that the event is canceled.
usages.sentenceZh: 我们遗憾地通知您活动取消了。
usages.rephrase: We are sorry to tell you that the event is canceled.

usages.label: 懊悔
usages.sentence: He regretted his rude words immediately.
usages.sentenceZh: 他立刻对自己粗鲁的话语感到懊悔。
usages.explain: 对刚发生的事感到后悔。
usages.rephrase: He felt sorry for his rude words right away.

derivatives.note: regret 的重读闭音节双写 t 加 ed
derivatives.exampleSentence: He regretted not studying harder for the exam.
derivatives.exampleZh: 他后悔没有为考试更努力地学习。

induct.title: 重读闭音节双写末尾字母
induct.tip: 动词以重读闭音节结尾，末尾只有一个辅音字母时，双写该字母再加 ed

derivatives.note: regret + able 表示令人遗憾的
derivatives.exampleSentence: It is regrettable that the concert was cancelled at the last minute.
derivatives.exampleZh: 音乐会在最后一刻被取消，真是令人遗憾。

induct.title: 形容词后缀 -able
induct.tip: 动词或名词加 able 表示“可……的”或“令人……的”

derivatives.note: regret + ful 表示感到遗憾的
derivatives.exampleSentence: She gave a regretful smile as she said goodbye.
derivatives.exampleZh: 她说再见时露出了遗憾的微笑。

induct.title: 形容词后缀 -ful
induct.tip: 名词加 ful 构成形容词，表示充满……的

examExamples.readSentence: She regretted not taking the opportunity when it came.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 她后悔机会来临时没有抓住。

examExamples.readSentence: I regret to inform you that your application was unsuccessful.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 我很遗憾地通知你，你的申请未成功。

examExamples.readSentence: The loss of the game was a regrettable result for the team.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 输掉比赛对这个队来说是一个令人遗憾的结果。

examExamples.readSentence: He felt regretful about the harsh words he had said.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 他对自己说过的刻薄话感到后悔。

examTarget.note: 考点：regret 的过去式双写 t 规则，以及 regrettable（令人遗憾的）与 regretful（感到遗憾的）的区别，常出现在语法填空和写作中。

defA2: Having a value that is good enough for the time, money, or effort spent.
defReadAloud: Having a value that is good enough for the time, money, or effort spent.

usages.label: 值得
usages.sentence: This book is worth reading.
usages.sentenceZh: 这本书值得一读。
usages.rephrase: It is good to read this book.

usages.label: 价值
usages.sentence: The painting is worth a lot of money.
usages.sentenceZh: 这幅画值很多钱。
usages.rephrase: The painting is very expensive.

usages.label: 值得的
usages.sentence: It was a long trip, but it was worth it.
usages.sentenceZh: 旅程很长，但很值得。
usages.rephrase: The trip was long, but we enjoyed it.

derivatives.exampleSentence: This book is worthy of being read again.
derivatives.exampleZh: 这本书值得再读一遍。

induct.title: worth 族变形
induct.tip: 注意 worth 后接名词或动名词，worthy of 后接名词或动名词被动式。

derivatives.exampleSentence: The old map turned out to be worthless.
derivatives.exampleZh: 那张旧地图结果毫无价值。

induct.title: worth 族变形
induct.tip: 注意 worth 后接名词或动名词，worthy of 后接名词或动名词被动式。

derivatives.note: worth + while → 值得花时间的
derivatives.exampleSentence: It is worthwhile to spend time with family.
derivatives.exampleZh: 花时间陪伴家人是值得的。

induct.title: worth 族变形
induct.tip: 注意 worth 后接名词或动名词，worthy of 后接名词或动名词被动式。

examExamples.readSentence: The movie is well worth watching.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 这部电影很值得看。

examExamples.readSentence: She is a worthy winner of the prize.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 她是一位当之无愧的获奖者。

examExamples.readSentence: Don't buy that cheap toy; it's completely worthless.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 别买那个便宜玩具，它完全没用。

examExamples.readSentence: Volunteering is a worthwhile experience.
examExamples.readSentenceZh: 做志愿者是一次值得的经历。

examTarget.note: 中文：考点 worth 词族变形，提醒掌握 worth/worthy/worthless/worthwhile 的用法区别。

defA2: To create or design something that has not existed before.
defReadAloud: To create or design something that has not existed before.

usages.label: 发明
usages.sentence: Thomas Edison invented the light bulb.
usages.sentenceZh: 托马斯·爱迪生发明了电灯泡。
